provenance: 20 hand-authored synthetic news-style templates x 6 numeric/entity variants. Bodies and headlines expanded without answer explanations; source-grounded v3 labels and scoring rubric preserved. Not independent real-news accuracy; results must be reported separately from the shorter v3 corpus.

cases.body: An operational notice issued ahead of the next roster cycle sets out the arrangements at Port Delta. Port Delta strike duration is 36 hours. The authority lists the affected berths in an annex and directs agents to the terminal desk for individual cargo enquiries. Shipping agents circulated the notice to carriers and cargo owners preparing vessel calls. The operational circular also covers berth assignments, documentation requirements and contacts for refrigerated cargo, while commercial teams are reviewing delivery commitments with customers. Local offices are handling booking enquiries alongside their routine clearance work.
cases.headline: Port Delta publishes stoppage timetable

cases.body: Carriers received a revised operational circular after talks between the terminal operator and labour representatives. Port Delta strike duration increased from 12 hours to 36 hours. The revised timetable is now the basis for berth planning, and agents are contacting customers whose cargo bookings fall within the stoppage window. Shipping agents circulated the notice to carriers and cargo owners preparing vessel calls. The operational circular also covers berth assignments, documentation requirements and contacts for refrigerated cargo, while commercial teams are reviewing delivery commitments with customers. Local offices are handling booking enquiries alongside their routine clearance work.
cases.headline: Port Delta revises strike arrangements

cases.body: A revised notice was distributed to vessel agents following discussions with labour representatives. Port Delta strike duration decreased from 36 hours to 12 hours. Terminal coordinators have incorporated the revised window into the working roster and are confirming arrangements with individual carriers. Shipping agents circulated the notice to carriers and cargo owners preparing vessel calls. The operational circular also covers berth assignments, documentation requirements and contacts for refrigerated cargo, while commercial teams are reviewing delivery commitments with customers. Local offices are handling booking enquiries alongside their routine clearance work.
cases.headline: Port Delta revises stoppage window after talks

cases.body: The authority at Port Delta issued a clarification after a report about the stoppage circulated among freight forwarders. Port Delta strike duration did not increase from 12 to 36 hours. A spokesperson referred booking questions to the operations desk, which is handling requests from shipping agents and cargo owners. Shipping agents circulated the notice to carriers and cargo owners preparing vessel calls. The operational circular also covers berth assignments, documentation requirements and contacts for refrigerated cargo, while commercial teams are reviewing delivery commitments with customers. Local offices are handling booking enquiries alongside their routine clearance work.
cases.headline: Port Delta responds to disputed strike report

cases.body: Terminal operators at Port Delta circulated a planning bulletin covering the stoppage windows listed for affected shifts. Port Delta strike duration ranges from 12 to 36 hours. The accompanying annex identifies the berths and shift rosters covered by the bulletin, with vessel-specific arrangements handled by local coordinators. Shipping agents circulated the notice to carriers and cargo owners preparing vessel calls. The operational circular also covers berth assignments, documentation requirements and contacts for refrigerated cargo, while commercial teams are reviewing delivery commitments with customers. Local offices are handling booking enquiries alongside their routine clearance work.
cases.headline: Port Delta outlines stoppage arrangements across shifts

cases.body: Negotiators at Port Delta discussed an alternative stoppage timetable during a meeting with terminal representatives. Port Delta strike duration could increase from 12 to 36 hours. The option remains on the agenda for discussions with carriers, and the authority has asked operational teams to prepare contingency schedules for review. Shipping agents circulated the notice to carriers and cargo owners preparing vessel calls. The operational circular also covers berth assignments, documentation requirements and contacts for refrigerated cargo, while commercial teams are reviewing delivery commitments with customers. Local offices are handling booking enquiries alongside their routine clearance work.
cases.headline: Port Delta considers contingency timetable

cases.body: A logistics briefing combines the operating bulletin for Port Delta with a separate commercial update from freight forwarders. Port Delta strike duration ranges from 12 to 36 hours. Shipping costs increased. Agents are reviewing both notices while responding to customer enquiries about routing and delivery commitments. Shipping agents circulated the notice to carriers and cargo owners preparing vessel calls. The operational circular also covers berth assignments, documentation requirements and contacts for refrigerated cargo, while commercial teams are reviewing delivery commitments with customers. Local offices are handling booking enquiries alongside their routine clearance work.

cases.body: Forwarders circulated a regional briefing combining terminal arrangements and carrier pricing. Port Delta strike duration ranges from 12 to 36 hours and shipping costs increased. The accompanying pages cover berth availability, commercial quotations and cargo documentation, with account managers preparing responses to customer enquiries. Shipping agents circulated the notice to carriers and cargo owners preparing vessel calls. The operational circular also covers berth assignments, documentation requirements and contacts for refrigerated cargo, while commercial teams are reviewing delivery commitments with customers. cases.headline: Port Delta operations and freight pricing feature in briefing

cases.body: A US economic briefing for corporate finance teams brings together the policy statement and a separate consumer-price release. US policy rate is 4.0 percent. US inflation is 2.0 percent. The policy statement discusses monetary conditions, while the price release describes developments in the consumer basket. The releases were circulated to corporate planning teams alongside commentary on household spending and supplier negotiations. Treasury staff are reviewing local operating budgets, contract indexation clauses and the timing of customer receipts, with country offices preparing their own briefings for the regional finance meeting.
cases.headline: US policy rate and inflation feature in corporate briefing

cases.body: Germany's statistical office published its latest annual consumer-price reading as companies prepared their European operating-cost reviews. German inflation is 4.0 percent. A separate release from France was also included in the briefing pack. French inflation is 2.0 percent. Both releases cover September. The releases were circulated to corporate planning teams alongside commentary on household spending and supplier negotiations. Treasury staff are reviewing local operating budgets, contract indexation clauses and the timing of customer receipts, with country offices preparing their own briefings for the regional finance meeting.
cases.headline: German consumer prices lead European operating-cost review

cases.body: The latest US consumer-price release is being reviewed ahead of corporate budget meetings. US annual inflation is 4.0 percent. Further down the release, the section on the latest reporting month states that US monthly inflation is 2.0 percent. The accompanying commentary discusses the composition of the consumer basket. The releases were circulated to corporate planning teams alongside commentary on household spending and supplier negotiations. Treasury staff are reviewing local operating budgets, contract indexation clauses and the timing of customer receipts, with country offices preparing their own briefings for the regional finance meeting.

Banks circulated the statement to corporate clients, while finance teams reviewed funding calendars and the repricing provisions in their borrowing agreements. The releases were circulated to corporate planning teams alongside commentary on household spending and supplier negotiations. Treasury staff are reviewing local operating budgets, contract indexation clauses and the timing of customer receipts, with country offices preparing their own briefings for the regional finance meeting.

Treasury staff are reviewing local operating budgets, contract indexation clauses and the timing of customer receipts, with country offices preparing their own briefings for the regional finance meeting.
